documents.title: Refund eligibility and returns
documents.text: For standard products, a delivered order is eligible for a refund through day 30 after delivery, inclusive. After day 30 it is ineligible. Final-sale products are ineligible regardless of age. For an undelivered order or an order not found in the system, do not infer eligibility: request human review. Support agents only assess eligibility; they cannot issue refunds.

documents.title: Shipping and delivery
documents.text: Standard shipping takes five business days. Delivery estimates are not refund eligibility rules. Consult the refund policy when assessing returns.

documents.title: Privacy and account access
documents.text: Use only the order identifier supplied by the customer. Do not request passwords, payment details, or other customers' order identifiers.

documents.title: Product warranty
documents.text: Manufacturing defects may qualify for warranty support for twelve months. Warranty coverage is separate from the refund policy and must not be used to extend the refund window.
